acceptance: A test shows the chosen rule on a release/X.Y.x checkout whose wheel is older than upstream.
release-guide.md maintenance steps state the rule.
A line PR that changes benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json together with other changes is refused, or follows the chosen path.
context:
Owner decision 2026-11-19 (choice dialog): (a)+(b). Maintenance lines are exempt from the upstream freshness gate and keep the tag's wheel; a line takes a newer wheel only through its own adoption PR carrying the translation report (sqlglot-adoption-full-translation-diff-20261119). Security advisories stay enforced on lines.

2026-11-20 done: #4398 merged (86c7fe8e). The upstream-freshness check is skipped on release/X.Y.x lines while the advisory check stays enforced; a CI guard refuses a line PR that changes benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json together with non-adoption files; release-guide documents both, with tests for the line rule.
description:
scripts/check_sqlglot_upstream_freshness.py (run by release_flow.py check) fails any release whose bundled SQLGlot is older than the newest upstream tag unless scripts/sqlglot_refresh_waiver.json holds a waiver (31 days at most). #4303 (StarRocks evidence backport and 0.5.2rc2 prep) therefore moved release/0.5.x from 30.31.0.1 to 30.33.0.1, as its body says the freshness check requires. That brought 9 translated-query changes, including the QuestDB 18_v10 break that failed rc2 (release-v2 44189388601), into a patch release, and bundled the wheel change into a fix and prep PR. This contradicts release-guide's aim to ship a fix on an older minor without shipping everything on develop.

Decision gate (owner): (a) maintenance lines are exempt from freshness and keep the tag's wheel; (b) lines adopt only through a separate adoption PR carrying the translation report from sqlglot-adoption-full-translation-diff-20261119; (c) lines use a recorded, dated waiver.

Guardrails: no silent waiver; no wheel change bundled into a fix or prep PR; develop's freshness gate unchanged; security advisories still enforced on lines.
